entities.name: Peace Talks at Kroog
entities.description: The second of two peace summits preceding the start of the Brothers' War, initiated by Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza who initiated the summit, acquired more dragon engines, and obtained Urza's Mightstone by deception.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Yotian artificer who refused to hand over the Mightstone and led an aerial assault on a decoy.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Urza's wife, who wanted the deal and secretly stole his Mightstone for Mishra.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A Fallaji figure who lured Tawnos away and was taken prisoner.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's associate who realized something was amiss and woke Urza.

entities.name: Sharaman
entities.description: Urza's lieutenant who spotted the War Machine.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Place from which Mishra acquired three more dragon engines.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Yotian city where the summit took place and which was destroyed in the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's power stone, which the treaty demanded he hand to Mishra.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's power stone, used to zap Urza.

entities.name: War Machine
entities.description: A large automated machine left as bait for Urza.

entities.name: Sword Marches
entities.description: Region the treaty would acknowledge as Yotian territory.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: The destruction of Kroog by Mishra's forces.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

events.summary: Mishra initiates the second summit, held with only Yotia and the Fallaji Empire, after acquiring three more dragon engines.
events.quote: it was Mishra who initiated the invitation to the summit

events.summary: A treaty is proposed but Urza refuses to hand the Mightstone to Mishra, arguing loudly with his wife Kayla.
events.quote: Urza refused this and got into a very loud argument with his wife

events.summary: Ashnod lures Tawnos away while Kayla gets Urza drunk, steals the Mightstone, delivers it to Mishra and sleeps with him.
events.quote: She then went to Mishra's quarters, delivered the stone to him, and slept with him.

events.summary: Urza confronts Mishra and the stones battle; Urza lowers his stone and Mishra zaps him with the Weakstone and leaves, the Fallaji withdraw, and Ashnod is taken prisoner.
events.quote: This allowed Mishra to zap him with the Weakstone and barge out.

events.summary: Weeks later Sharaman spots the War Machine and Urza leads an aerial assault; the automated machine shoots down every ornithopter but Urza's, and he destroys it by bombing.
events.quote: Urza managed to destroy the device by bombing it

events.summary: While Urza is lured away by the decoy, Mishra's forces strike Kroog, destroying it in the Fall of Kroog.
events.quote: Mishra's forces struck directly at Kroog

relations.note: brothers on the brink of the Brothers' War
relations.quote: Urza was livid and sent several scouts into the desert to track Mishra

relations.note: secretly delivered the Mightstone to him
relations.quote: Kayla got her husband severely drunk and then stole his Mightstone away

relations.note: part of the Fallaji plan against Urza
